places.name: Tirthan Riverside Campsite & Bonfire Haven
places.tagline: Pristine riverside alpine tents surrounded by cedar pines and trout streams
places.description: Pitch under towering pine canopies beside the bubbling Tirthan River. Features luxury canvas tents, private firepits, freshly caught trout barbecue, and night sky astronomy.

nearby_locations.name: Tirthan River Trout Angling Pool
nearby_locations.description: Crystal clear glacial waters where river trout spawn under pine branches.

nearby_locations.name: Chhoie Waterfall Sacred Trail
nearby_locations.description: Mystic mountain falls cascading into an icy blue plunge basin nestled in deodars.

nearby_locations.name: Great Himalayan National Park Gate
nearby_locations.description: UNESCO World Heritage biodiversity boundary with rare Western Tragopan trails.

nearby_locations.name: Sharchi Traditional Ridge Hamlet
nearby_locations.description: Ancient Kath-Kuni village perched on the rim overlooking the entire Tirthan canyon.

places.name: Jibhi Pine Woods Heritage Homestay
places.tagline: Handcrafted Kath-Kuni cedar wood homestay nestled beside cascading waterfalls
places.description: Live with a native Himachali family in a centuries-old slate and cedar mansion. Savor traditional Siddu, organic apple chutneys, and fall asleep to the gentle mountain breeze.

nearby_locations.name: Jibhi Hidden Waterfall & Wood Bridges
nearby_locations.description: Charming moss-covered stone trail across wooden bridges to a singing waterfall.

nearby_locations.name: Chehni Kothi 1500-Year Fort Tower
nearby_locations.description: Towering earthquake-proof timber-and-stone architectural marvel built without cement.

nearby_locations.name: Jalori Pass & Serolsar Lake Trail (3,120m)
nearby_locations.description: Wind-swept ridge pass connecting Kullu and Shimla with sacred emerald forest lake.

nearby_locations.name: Shoja Pine Canopy Viewpoint
nearby_locations.description: Quiet panoramic sunset meadow facing snow-crested Dhauladhar peaks.

places.name: Kasol Chalal Riverside Glamping Camp
places.tagline: Quiet bohemian riverside bell-tents tucked under deodar canopies
places.description: Escape the main strip to the tranquil banks of Chalal. Enjoy riverside geodesic dome tents, wood-fired bread making, hammocks over clear glacial water, and starlit gatherings.

nearby_locations.name: Chalal Riverside Suspension Footbridge
nearby_locations.description: Wooden suspension bridge crossing turquoise glacial rapids into bohemian pine groves.

nearby_locations.name: Manikaran Natural Hot Sulphur Springs
nearby_locations.description: Sacred natural mineral geothermal waters and historic Gurudwara alongside river.

nearby_locations.name: Grahan Village Fairy Deodar Trail
nearby_locations.description: Ancient honey-producing car-free mountain hamlet guarded by towering Himalayan pines.

nearby_locations.name: Tosh Glacier Waterfall & Cafe Ridge
nearby_locations.description: Amphitheater village facing massive glacial waterfalls and snow-dusted cirques.

places.name: Spiti Valley Mud & Stone Monastery Homestay
places.tagline: High-altitude Tibetan mud-brick home with panoramic monastery and Milky Way views
places.description: Experience authentic Spitian hospitality at 3,800m. Stay in a traditional solar-heated mud-brick home with butter tea by the Bukhari stove and breathtaking view of Key Monastery.

nearby_locations.name: Key 1,000-Year Gompa Monastery
nearby_locations.description: Ancient Tibetan Buddhist fortress monastery at 4,166m with centuries of sacred murals.

nearby_locations.name: Kibber Snow Leopard Wildlife Sanctuary
nearby_locations.description: High-altitude stone village at 4,270m, habitat for ibex, Tibetan wolves and snow leopards.

nearby_locations.name: Chicham Deep Gorge Suspension Bridge
nearby_locations.description: Asia's highest suspension bridge spanning a jaw-dropping 150m deep rocky canyon.

nearby_locations.name: Hikkim World's Highest Post Office
nearby_locations.description: Post a genuine postcard to anywhere on earth from 4,400 meters elevation.

places.name: Pangi Valley Remote Alpine Campsite
places.tagline: Raw wilderness expedition campsite beneath the dramatic Sach Pass cliffs
places.description: For genuine adventure seekers: all-weather dome tents surrounded by soaring jagged Himalayan spires, Pangwali village campfires, and untouched trails along the Chenab canyon.

nearby_locations.name: Sach Pass Snow-Cut High Ridge (4,420m)
nearby_locations.description: Legendary Himalayan mountain pass carved through towering walls of ancient snow.

nearby_locations.name: Chenab River Deep Granite Canyon
nearby_locations.description: Roaring grey glacial river thundering between 1,000-meter sheer rock spires.

nearby_locations.name: Killar Ancient Pangwali Tribal Village
nearby_locations.description: Untouched tribal stone dwellings preserved by winter isolation and raw mountain solace.

places.name: Parvati Valley Apple Orchard Homestay
places.tagline: Rustic orchard retreat with glacier views, sourdough bakes and organic herbs
places.description: Perched above the valley floor in peaceful Kalga, surrounded by blooming apple trees and mountain mist. Cozy wooden rooms, herbal tea foraging, and serene writing spaces.

nearby_locations.name: Kalga Golden Apple Orchard Trails
nearby_locations.description: Car-free village pathways flanked by fragrant apple trees, chamomile and mossy fences.

nearby_locations.name: Kheerganga Thermal Hot Bath Peak Trail
nearby_locations.description: Natural hot spring bath atop meadow plateau surrounded by snow-clad peaks.

nearby_locations.name: Pulga Ancient Fairy Forest
nearby_locations.description: Misty deodar woodland with century-old fallen giants and serene walking glades.

experiences.title: Hidden Cedar Forest & Waterfall Trail
experiences.description: Traverse forgotten pathways beneath hundred-year-old cedar trees to a hidden waterfall gorge. Learn native tree lore and enjoy mountain spring water.

experiences.title: Authentic Himachali Dham & Chha Gosht Feast
experiences.description: Learn the secret spices of traditional Kangri/Kulluvi festive Dham cooked in brass pots over wood embers. Feast on Madra, Sepu Vadi, and Babru.

experiences.title: Old Key Monastery Morning Chants & Meditation
experiences.description: Sit quietly with Tibetan Buddhist monks as dawn light illuminates Key Monastery. Listen to ancient rhythmic chanting and horn resonance.

experiences.title: Kath-Kuni Indigenous Woodcraft Workshop
experiences.description: Learn the interlocking timber-and-slate dry masonry technique that has kept Himalayan homes standing through major seismic tremors for centuries.

experiences.title: High Altitude Bortle-1 Milky Way Astronomy
experiences.description: Stand beneath unpolluted skies at 4,400 meters. View Saturn rings, Andromeda Galaxy, and the glowing arc of the Milky Way through an 8-inch Dobsonian telescope.

locals.name: Rahul Thakur
locals.bio: Born and raised in Jibhi. Rahul has walked every ridgeline between Jalori Pass and the Tirthan River. Passionate about preserving fragile cedar forests and slow Himalayan trails.

locals.name: Tsering Dolma
locals.bio: Specialist in Trans-Himalayan medicinal plants and Tibetan cultural heritage. Leads conscious slow-travel journeys across Spiti's highest villages with deep spiritual respect.

locals.name: Hemraj Sharma
locals.bio: Guardian of Kullu folk epics, temple architecture folklore, and acoustic mountain flute melodies. An evening with Hemraj turns firelit courtyards into living history.

locals.name: Meena Negi
locals.bio: Grew up foraging morel mushrooms and wild mint in the Great Himalayan National Park buffer zone. Enthusiastic about sharing indigenous recipes and river tranquility.

locals.name: Chuni Lal Sharma
locals.bio: Over 25 years traversing the raw cliffs of Pangi and Sach Pass. Unmatched wilderness instincts and guardian of Pangwali mountain tradition.

locals.name: Padma Chodon
locals.bio: Master weaver preserving geometric Kinnauri textile patterns and singing historic Baspa valley harvest verses. Warm, welcoming, and deeply rooted.
